story.so_that: automated refinement never silently redefines what passing means
story.i_want: every proposed evaluation expectation change to be bound to an explicit, durable approval decision before it is applied

acceptance_criteria.criterion: EDD-005-AC1: Given the selected action proposes changing an evaluation expectation, including an LLM rubric, when the workflow reaches the approval step, then it pauses durably and waits for an explicit human decision bound to the exact proposed diff or a stable proposal identifier.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the selected action proposes changing an evaluation expectation including an LLM rubric when the workflow reaches the approval step then it pauses durably and waits for an explicit human decision bound to the exact proposed diff or a stable proposal identifier

acceptance_criteria.criterion: EDD-005-AC2: Given an approval request is pending, when no decision is received before the configured approval timeout, then the workflow treats the absence of a decision as no approval, never as implicit approval.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given an approval request is pending when no decision is received before the configured approval timeout then the workflow treats the absence of a decision as no approval and never as implicit approval

acceptance_criteria.criterion: EDD-005-AC3: Given a human rejects the proposed evaluation change, when the rejection is recorded, then the workflow returns to planning or stops according to policy, and the change is not applied.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a human rejects the proposed evaluation change when the rejection is recorded then the workflow returns to planning or stops according to policy and the change is not applied

acceptance_criteria.criterion: EDD-005-AC4: Given a human approves the exact proposed diff, when execution proceeds, then only the approved diff is applied and it is recorded as a human-approved evaluation change distinct from a skill-behavior change.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a human approves the exact proposed diff when execution proceeds then only the approved diff is applied and it is recorded as a human-approved evaluation change distinct from a skill-behavior change

acceptance_criteria.criterion: EDD-005-AC5: Given a worker restarts while a run is waiting for approval, when the workflow resumes, then it continues waiting on the same pending approval without losing the proposal context.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a worker restarts while a run is waiting for approval when the workflow resumes then it continues waiting on the same pending approval without losing the proposal context

edge_cases.criterion: Proposed diff is empty or does not change an evaluation expectation
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the selected action does not change an evaluation expectation when the workflow reaches the approval step then it does not pause for human approval and continues without requiring a decision

edge_cases.criterion: Proposal identifier is not stable or not found on resume
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the stable proposal identifier cannot be resolved when the workflow resumes then the workflow treats it as a failed approval and routes to planning or stops

edge_cases.criterion: Approval decision is received after timeout
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the approval request has already timed out when a late approve or reject decision is recorded then the decision is ignored and the timeout path has already been taken

edge_cases.criterion: Multiple approval decisions are submitted for the same proposal
edge_cases.gherkin: Given multiple approval decisions are submitted for the same proposal identifier when the workflow processes them then only the first valid decision is recorded and subsequent decisions are rejected

edge_cases.criterion: Workflow resumes on a different worker after restart
edge_cases.gherkin: Given a worker process restarts while a run is waiting for approval when a different worker picks up the workflow then it resumes in the same waiting state and continues from the same proposal context
Given the human approval channel is unavailable when the workflow attempts to create the approval request then the workflow fails without treating the unnotified request as approved

edge_cases.criterion: Approved diff differs from the originally proposed diff
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the diff bound to the approval record differs from the diff being executed when the workflow attempts to apply the change then execution is rejected and the change is not applied

ui: Approval review interface for proposed evaluation expectation diffs
Approval history and measurement context viewer
api: EddRefinementWorkflow approval gate and bounded wait loop
external_services: Trusted human decision channel / notification system

steps.description: Extend PlanningResult to carry proposal_id and proposed_diff_hash
Add approval gate to EddRefinementWorkflow for propose_evaluation_expectation_change actions
Define ApprovalRequest data model and persist it in ProgressRecord
Implement RequestHumanApproval activity to write the durable approval request
Implement _await_approval bounded wait using wait_condition and sleep
Add approve_evaluation_change signal and get_approval_status query
Validate executed diff hash against the approved diff hash before application
Route rejection or timeout to planning or stop according to policy
Write Human approve_evaluation_change signal script, support getting approval status, and ids. Follow helper script pattern

unit_tests.description: Approval gate branches only for propose_evaluation_expectation_change
Timeout is treated as no approval
ProgressRecord schema version 2 serializes and deserializes approval state

integration_tests.description: End-to-end approval wait with signal vs. timeout
ProgressRecord persistence and resume across worker restart

e2e_tests.description: Human approver reviews, approves, and sees the approved change recorded
Rejection returns the workflow to planning

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Cadence wait implementation could introduce non-determinism
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Reuse the existing story_analysis_workflow wait_condition/sleep race pattern

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Worker restart loses pending approval state or proposal context
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Persist the approval request in ProgressRecord and reload via create_or_resume

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Approved diff is silently mutated after approval
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Recompute and compare the diff hash before application; reject on mismatch

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Implicit approval from timeout or channel failure
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Treat timeout and missing decisions as no approval; fail the workflow if the approval request cannot be created

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Human-approved changes are conflated with skill-behavior changes in audit
